verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's pricing page documents next-business-day direct deposit (run by 5:00 PM) and same-day direct deposit (run by 7:00 AM). Its docs also confirm direct-deposit paychecks, auto payroll for direct-deposit employees, and employees entering their own direct deposit info, which together cover paying by fast deposit instead of checks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit timing, and clear documentation of which plan tiers include next-day versus same-day deposit.
